answer: Rewards here arrive like a slow tide rather than a lump sum: an agent's earnings vest over many epochs, and at any point a random auditor may rerun one of its old tasks. A sybil operator who spun up hundreds of accounts must keep every one of them doing honest, checkable work for weeks, or watch unvested pay vanish when a single audit fails. A fake identity burns out like a comet; only a real worker, rooted like a lotus in steady output, ever collects in full.
